comment: Wizard metadata for the optional (non-core) tools in loom.toml. Keys must match the manifest's tool keys exactly; the catalog generator validates both directions.

tools.label: loom-teams
tools.description: Teams/Outlook calendar as data over Microsoft Graph — export meetings as JSON, find scored meeting slots.
tools.nextAction: Run `loom-teams setup` once and sign in, then `loom-teams find <name>`.

tools.label: pi
tools.description: The Pi coding agent. Required by Pi packages — selecting any of them pulls Pi in automatically.
tools.nextAction: Run `pi` in a project to start the agent.

tools.label: herdr
tools.description: Terminal multiplexer for coding agents (macOS/Linux; use WSL2 on Windows).
tools.nextAction: Run `herdr` to start the multiplexer.

tools.label: calldiff
tools.description: Diff call stacks across git commits — who-calls-whom across 22 languages (diff, tree, reach).
tools.nextAction: Run `calldiff diff` in a git repository.

tools.label: codegraph
tools.description: Local semantic code index for coding agents — source, call paths, and change impact without file-by-file discovery.
tools.nextAction: Run `loom init` in a project to wire agents and build its index.

tools.label: tuicr
tools.description: Code review TUI with vim keybindings - annotate diffs, PRs, or MRs and export to GitHub or clipboard.
tools.nextAction: Run `tuicr` in a repo with changes.

tools.label: gh
tools.description: GitHub CLI — the release, code-review, and jira skills use it for PRs and issues.
tools.nextAction: Run `gh auth login` once.

tools.label: glab
tools.description: GitLab CLI — the release and code-review skills use it for MRs on GitLab projects.
tools.nextAction: Run `glab auth login` once.

tools.label: tokei
tools.description: Fast code-statistics tool several skills shell out to for codebase orientation.
tools.nextAction: Run `tokei` in a repo.

tools.label: tokui
tools.description: Interactive TUI over tokei's statistics.
tools.nextAction: Run `tokei -o json | tokui` in a repo.

tools.label: uv
tools.description: Python package and project manager — the python skills assume it.
tools.nextAction: Run `uv init` in a Python project.

tools.label: agent-browser
tools.description: Browser automation CLI the browser-usage and e2e test skills drive.
tools.nextAction: Ask your agent to test a website.

tools.label: mermaid-cli
tools.description: Renders Mermaid diagrams to images (mmdc) — used by the diagram skills.
tools.nextAction: Ask your agent for a diagram.

tools.label: beads
tools.description: Beads (br): local-first issue tracker for coding agents — tasks in SQLite with JSONL export for git. Rust port of Steve Yegge's beads.
tools.nextAction: Run `loom init --tracker beads --yes` in a repo.

tools.label: beads-viewer
tools.description: Beads viewer (bv): graph-aware TUI over the Beads tracker — kanban, dependency DAG, critical path.
tools.nextAction: Run `bv` in a repo with Beads issues.

tools.label: glab-tui
tools.description: Terminal UI for GitLab and GitHub on top of glab/gh: issues, MRs, pipelines, runners, releases.
tools.nextAction: Run `glab-tui` in a repo with a GitLab or GitHub remote.

tools.label: gitleaks
tools.description: Secret scanner for git repos - catches committed credentials before they ship.
tools.nextAction: Run `gitleaks git` in a repo.

tools.label: zoxide
tools.description: Smarter cd that learns your habits: `z` jumps to frecent directories, `zi` picks interactively.
tools.nextAction: Add `eval "$(zoxide init zsh)"` to your shell profile, then `z <dir>`.

tools.label: envx
tools.description: Environment variable manager with a TUI and CLI. Native binaries on Linux/Windows; builds via cargo on macOS (crates.io `envex`).
tools.nextAction: Run `envx` to browse your environment.

tools.label: pup
tools.description: Datadog API CLI for agents and humans: 200+ commands over metrics, logs, monitors, traces.
tools.nextAction: Run `pup auth login` once.

tools.label: confluence-markdown-exporter
tools.description: Export Confluence pages, descendants, spaces, or organisations to Markdown.
tools.nextAction: Run `cme config edit auth.confluence` to configure authentication.

tools.label: plannotator
tools.description: Browser-based plan and code review for coding agents, with figure-led Guided Reviews: one document, a code peek, and in-app guides drawn by the changeset-walkthrough skill. The plannotator skills drive it.
tools.nextAction: In Claude Code run `/plugin marketplace add Yassimba/plannotator` and `/plugin install plannotator@plannotator`, then restart. Pick changeset-walkthrough in loom to get the figure-led guides.

tools.label: claude-obsidian
tools.description: An Obsidian Vault as Pi's project-local wiki: wiki-ingest, wiki-query, save, think, canvas, and autoresearch. By AgriciDaniel, MIT.
tools.nextAction: Run `loom wiki` to create or adopt a Vault.

tools.label: python
tools.description: Exact-pinned Python runtime required by claude-obsidian.
tools.nextAction: Run `loom wiki` to configure a Vault.
